title: Building a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for PostgreSQL databases
excerpt: Exposing database schemas, SQL query runners, and table metrics securely to large language models using the Model Context Protocol. Learn how to write tools in Python and run them in any MCP host.

title: Asynchronous Task Queuing in FastAPI: Celery vs. BackgroundTasks
excerpt: When should you use FastAPI's built-in BackgroundTasks versus a full-fledged distributed worker system like Celery and Redis? We compare latency, overhead, and reliability in backend services.

title: Why Vector Embeddings are Changing Database Schema Design
excerpt: A practical guide to implementing pgvector in PostgreSQL, designing high-recall index structures, and optimizing chunk retrieval strategies for production RAG pipelines.
